_comment: mobile-cockpit / pwa / config.json — PUBLIC PWA configuration. NOT secret. Loaded by app.js at boot. Values MUST stay in lockstep with flows/mobile-cockpit/lib/config.mjs; the static guard `tests/flows/mobile-cockpit/pwa-config-coherence.sh` enforces this.
_invariant: clientId/tenantId/scopes/stateRelativePath are mirrors of constants defined in lib/config.mjs (AZURE, GRAPH_SCOPES, STATE_RELATIVE_PATH). If you edit one, edit the other in the SAME commit.

sessionsIndex._comment: v2 session model (mobile follow-along, 2026-09-24). relativePath MUST match SESSIONS_INDEX_RELATIVE_PATH in lib/config.mjs. Coherence enforced by pwa-config-coherence.sh.

sessionsDir._comment: v2 per-session records live under this folder as <id>.json -- mirrors SESSIONS_DIR_RELATIVE_PATH + sessionRecordRelativePath(id) in lib/config.mjs.

claudeCodeTabs._comment: SPEC-DELTA-2026-09-28-claude-code-ide-tracker.md. Read-only mirror of Claude Code's own session transcripts, written by flows/mobile-cockpit/claude-code-mirror/poll.mjs. Same shape as ideTabs -- a SEPARATE file, no schema coupling between the two independently-evolving sources. relativePath MUST match CLAUDE_CODE_TABS_RELATIVE_PATH in claude-code-mirror/poll.mjs.

browserTabs._comment: SPEC-DELTA-2026-10-07-browser-tab-copilot-mirror.md. Read-only mirror of Copilot/Cowork browser tabs, written by flows/mobile-cockpit/browser-tab-mirror/poll.mjs. Own schema (no thread/waitingOn -- there is no transcript, just title + best-effort url). relativePath MUST match BROWSER_TABS_RELATIVE_PATH in browser-tab-mirror/poll.mjs.

digests._comment: SPEC-DELTA-2026-10-08-tracker-hover-digest.md (Layer B, optional). Written by flows/mobile-cockpit/summary-digest/poll.mjs only when DIGEST_ENABLED; a missing file just means the hover card shows the deterministic text. relativePath MUST match DIGESTS_RELATIVE_PATH in lib/config.mjs.

health._comment: SPEC task 12 (AC-008), wired 2026-09-25. relativePath MUST match HEALTH_RELATIVE_PATH in lib/config.mjs. Coherence enforced by pwa-config-coherence.sh.

daemonControl._comment: SPEC-DELTA-2026-09-27-daemon-control-watchdog. controlRelativePath/statusRelativePath MUST match DAEMON_CONTROL_RELATIVE_PATH/DAEMON_STATUS_RELATIVE_PATH in lib/config.mjs. Coherence enforced by pwa-config-coherence.sh. staleAfterSeconds is 3x the watchdog's own 1-minute Scheduled Task cadence -- past that, the PWA shows 'unknown' rather than trusting a possibly-dead watchdog's last write.

sharing._comment: SPEC-DELTA-2026-09-29-session-sharing-stage2. hostUpn/hostDisplayName/sharesRelativePath/guestRootFolder MUST match HOST_UPN/HOST_DISPLAY_NAME/SHARES_RELATIVE_PATH/GUEST_ROOT_FOLDER in lib/config.mjs (pwa-config-coherence). Any signed-in account other than hostUpn runs in guest mode and only ever touches its OWN drive under guestRootFolder.

ideTabs._comment: M2.1 read-only mirror of live Cursor IDE chat tabs, written by flows/mobile-cockpit/ide-mirror/poll.mjs. PWA fetches GET-only; ETag tracking is not required here. The relativePath MUST match IDE_TABS_RELATIVE_PATH in ide-mirror/poll.mjs (which derives from ONEDRIVE.folderName + 'ide-tabs.json'). pollIntervalSeconds is independent of pwa.pollIntervalSeconds so the lighter read-only path can refresh faster than the sessions list.

refreshSignals._comment: Mobile PWA writes ISO timestamps here when the user taps ↻. daemon/poll.mjs and ide-mirror/poll.mjs read this file and run an immediate mirror tick when they see a newer request. relativePath MUST match REFRESH_SIGNALS_RELATIVE_PATH in lib/config.mjs.

session._comment: Mirrors ALLOWED_CWDS + MODEL_OPTIONS from lib/config.mjs (design.md §7 L2 + L3). Coherence enforced by pwa-config-coherence.sh. `autoApprove` was removed 2026-09-26 (SPEC-DELTA-2026-09-26-ui-cleanup, item A) -- it was v1-only (gated v1's Approve button); AUTO_APPROVE_DEFAULT itself survives in lib/config.mjs since daemon/poll.mjs's own v1 tick loop still reads it (out of scope for this PWA-only cleanup).

pwa.redirectUriProdDoc: Set this to the OneDrive-share-link URL of pwa/index.html once Stage B (deploy) runs. For Stage A1 (local dev), only redirectUriDev matters.
